visualCharacteristics: Section heading over a grid of service-link cards (icon, title, short text, arrow); below about 728px it becomes a swipeable one-card carousel with dots, arrows and a Swipe/Stack toggle.
contentPattern: Rows: heading row, then one row per card (icon, title, description, link).
usage: "Service Status" row on the homepage; any grid of icon link cards.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for icon + title + text link card grids that should collapse into a carousel on small screens.
